definitions.itemSeen: One raw catalog record returned by a discovery API (one resource listing).
definitions.junkRemoved: Records dropped before analysis: non-HTTP(S) URLs, localhost/loopback/example domains, malformed URLs, or listings with no usable payment option.
definitions.usableListing: A catalog listing with a valid resource URL and at least one payment option.
definitions.optionKey: One canonical payment option (resource URL + network + scheme) expanded from a listing's accepts array.
definitions.uniqueKey: One deduplicated payment-option key within a source pull.
definitions.finalUnique: One deduplicated payment-option key across all sources. This is what "RESOURCES DISCOVERED" means.
